create_policy_manager: create a PolicyManager instance with a config object and number of agents for RL policy assignment
get_policy_for_agent: get the assigned policy index for a specific agent in a given environment using get_policy_for_agent
sample_policy: sample a random policy index from the policy population using the internal _sample_policy method
